concepts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: revised high-level game art exploration board for P0-04, original top-down 3D arcade city sandbox.
Primary request: Create a landscape palette comparison board with TWO equal large gameplay-camera panels side by side. A narrow dark title strip labels the left "VIOLET & CYAN" and the right "PETROL & CORAL". No other text except small palette swatches along the bottom. Both panels depict the SAME small everyday urban street corner and identical composition, but different dark vibrant color treatments. Camera MUST be directly vertically overhead, true 90-degree top-down plan view looking straight at the ground. Orthographic parallel projection. Roads run precisely vertically and horizontally on screen. All cars show ONLY roofs/bonnets/trunks seen from directly above; wheels are barely visible along the sides. Buildings show ONLY rooftop plans and parapets, NEVER front facades or side walls. Humans seen from directly above: heads, shoulders, arms and small feet. No isometric projection, no tilted camera, no oblique perspective, no horizon. Think playable GTA2 camera with original modern chunky stylized 3D art, not an architectural perspective.
Composition of each panel: dark road four-way intersection at center, sidewalks uninterrupted around four blocks; low-rise ordinary shops upper left, small plaza with round water tower roof upper right, conventional sawtooth workshop roof lower left and car repair yard lower right. Buildings are ordinary brick/concrete shops, apartment frontage, everyday warehouses, no futuristic architecture. Sparse rooftop details are useful large shapes only. One visible player on centre-right sidewalk in bright warm ivory/coral jacket holding a weapon and facing north, three pedestrians in vivid clothing well spaced, one compact magenta hatchback and one long amber sedan on roads. Two contrasting roof silhouettes, strong street-corner clarity. Small orange/ivory explosion far from player in yard, with restrained broken violet smoke; it must not hide nearby roads.
Left palette: deep ink blue asphalt (#151827), dark aubergine and saturated violet roofs (#352445, #5A347E), vivid turquoise/cyan architectural paint accents (#12D8CE), fuchsia awnings/rooftop trim (#ED3BB8), electric amber car (#FFB829), medium slate-lavender sidewalks, shadows deep navy. Rich saturated color, punchy light/dark separation, subtle colored fill gives dimension. Painted surfaces, tactile stylized shading and crisp edges. Small selective luminous sign accents, but most saturation comes from material colors and lighting.
Right palette: deep blue-teal asphalt, rich petrol and emerald roofs (#153D49, #176B64), saturated coral/orange awnings and cars (#FF5A58, #FF8B2B), strong cobalt-blue accents (#3156DA), medium cool gray sidewalk, warm amber highlights. Equally dark and vibrant, slightly warmer.
Lighting: fixed dry daytime, dark rich materials with visible detail and crisp short shadows, enough ambient illumination to read people. Cyberpunk influence ONLY through vibrant color combinations; keep normal architecture. This is not a nighttime city. Clean shaded volumetric forms, dark saturated midtones, no washed-out pastels, no flat beige blocks. Aim for appealing game production concept quality, expressive and playful rather than gritty photorealism.
Constraints: original designs, no franchise logos, no skyscrapers, no sci-fi buildings, holograms, cables, giant billboards, rain, wet reflections, dense clutter, full-screen bloom, fog, lens flare, tilt shift, depth of field, huge shadows, missions, police or HUD. Strict vertical top-down viewpoint is essential in BOTH panels. Concept reference only, not a game screenshot or measured layout.
